name: design-doc
description: Generate a Google-style engineering design doc (problem, goals/non-goals, options considered, recommended approach, risks, rollout) from a feature brief or short description. Use when the user wants to draft a design doc, technical proposal, or one-pager for an engineering review.

handoff.when: the design is written and needs rendering
handoff.purpose: Render the prose as a diagram that must not disagree with it.
handoff.fallback: If architecture-diagrams is absent, emit Mermaid inline and check every node against a claim in the doc.

model.rationale: Measured (RFC-0073): on its held-out evals the light tier met 88% and 88% of checks in two tier trials, against standard's 92% and heavy's 91% and 91%, within 5 points of the best both times.
